name: Jet Investment

entity_kind.quote: Jet Investment’s private equity funds invest in medium-sized industrial companies in Central Europe with strong growth potential.

sectors.quote: Jet Investment a.s., a Czech investment company founded in 1997, specializes in investments in Central European industry.

ticket_min.quote: Preferovaná výška jednej investície: min. 15 mil. EUR equity, max. 50 mil. EUR equity investícia

ticket_max.quote: Preferovaná výška jednej investície: min. 15 mil. EUR equity, max. 50 mil. EUR equity investícia

aum.quote: It manages assets totaling CZK 17 billion, including uncalled capital, across four qualified investor funds.

investments.quote: The Jet Investment Group has made its eleventh investment through the venture capital fund Jet Venture 1 SICAV, investing $1.8 million in AppNava Inc., a technology company that has developed an AI-powered SaaS platform for predictive analytics in mobile apps.
The Jet Investment Group, through its Jet 3 fund, is expanding the Náš Chléb group with the addition of Ostrava-based bakery PEKAŘI a spol.
The Jet Investment has made its tenth investment through the Jet Venture 1 SICAV venture capital fund investing €2.1 million in Phantasma Labs

notes: Brno-based industrial PE manager that also runs a VC fund (Jet Venture 1, target EUR 50m, early-stage tech) and an industrial real estate fund. AUM (CZK 17bn incl. uncalled capital) covers all four funds incl. real estate; homepage separately states EUR 700m+ AUM. Tickets are for the PE strategy (SLOVCA profile). No Slovak deal verified; SK in active_in per SLOVCA geographic focus.
